recentItems.title: NBC Nightly News with Tom Llamas Full Episode - Sept. 17
recentItems.description:
Tonight: A Texas Air National Guard F-16 fighter jet crashed and triggered evacuations in Michigan. The pilot was successfully evacuated. We'll have new details of tonight's breaking news. Plus, a Volaris flight from Las Vegas to Mexico had to turn around after the engine began spitting bursts of fire. The FAA says the pilots reported a possible engine fire. And flooding rains are inundating neighborhoods and first responders used helicopters to rescue people trapped in their vehicles. With millions of Americans now under flood alerts, NBC News’ Morgan Chesky is tracking it all. Also,Princess Diana’s brother is set to release an explosive new memoir, reflecting on her life and the turbulent days following her death. Early excerpts, published in The Daily Mail, drawing a rare and tense response from Buckingham Palace. And in 'Good News Tonight' at Candy’s Creek Cherokee Elementary School, janitor Ronald Harrison helps keep the classrooms clean and ready for learning. When his truck broke down, the school community raised money to get him back on the road.
